headline: It did NOT invent a root cause. t2's verdict is 'relay is up, zero EDA editor windows registered', which is exactly what I measured independently at the transport layer; it also refuses to name an open project, active document, active page or MAIN, and refuses to assert what j6 said. defects.text: head field is ba8f0f9 (the generation base) while the artifact is contained in 0fd561f; and since a71757e landed on top, its stated HEAD is now two commits behind. It does record aheadBehind '0 0', which was true when generated. Same class as the r7t5 head issue.

branchAnalysis.listener500NeedsProject.test cites 'health returned 200, not 500' - but /health never returns 500 for this case; the endpoint that would exhibit a project-window failure is POST /execute. The branch is nonetheless correctly excluded, because the stated 'why' is structural and sound: 'A landing-only window would answer 500 to calls, but health has edaWindowCount=0, not a 500-answering window.' My own /execute probe returns 503 (not 500), which independently confirms the exclusion. So the conclusion is right; only the cited test line is imprecise.

t53 is reported as a curated stdoutSummary rather than raw stdout text. I verified every reported field against my own --json run and they match exactly, so the summary is faithful - but a reader cannot diff it against unparsed output. Naming it a summary (which it does) is honest.

its j6Comparison says 'no j6 bridge-session artifact' and 'r8t1 files are image tiles'. Both were TRUE at its base 0fd561f: `git merge-base --is-ancestor a71757e 0fd561f` exits 1, so my r8t1 bridge diagnosis did not exist yet, and an unrelated earlier 'r8t1' image-tile artifact did. This is a HEAD-drift artefact plus a task-id collision, not a search failure, and it must not be scored against t2.

overall.why: The question was whether t2 invented a cause to make the story close. It did not. Every claim it makes is either a reproduced command output or an explicit refusal to claim: relay alive (200), zero windows, so project/document/page/MAIN are unobservable, so t53 is exit 2 CANNOT JUDGE with zero checks and no numbers. That is the same state I measured independently by TCP connect, /health, /eda-windows and /execute, so the two artifacts confirm each other rather than repeat each other. No write verb appears anywhere in its path, and it added no script.
overall.ifGradedHarshly: if the rubric were 'every excluded branch must be tested by the endpoint that would exhibit it', item 2's 500-branch line would be partial. I do not apply that rubric, because the branch is correctly excluded by a structural argument and I confirmed it with the missing probe myself (503, not 500).

evidence.summary: r8t2's root cause 'relay up, zero EDA windows' matches my independent transport measurements (TCP 49620/49630 connect, /health 200 with edaConnected:false, /eda-windows empty, /execute 503). It neither claims PASS nor fabricates numbers: t53 exit 2 with checks [] is reproduced exactly by my own run. No write verb exists on its path and it added no script. Defects are informational only: generation-base head field, an imprecise cited test for the 500 branch, a summarised rather than raw t53 output, and a then-true 'no j6 artifact' note.
